description: This file defines an abstract base class for API tests in a Selenium NUnit test project. It manages setup routines and validation for API testing, including configuration loading and safety checks for discovery mode.

classes.name: ApiTestBase
classes.description: An abstract class that provides common setup and validation methods for API test classes, ensuring proper configuration and safety checks.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes API settings and API client before each test execution.

methods.name: GuardDiscoveryOnly
methods.description: Performs assertions to ensure necessary environment variables are set, especially when in discovery-only mode.
